spec.claim_summary: Buy bitcoin on every day price is more than 5% below its most recent high, compared against daily dollar-cost averaging.
assumptions: Asset is Bitcoin, mapped to BTCUSDT spot.
Timeframe 1d comes from page context, not stated by claimant.
Most Recent High Price interpreted as trailing highest_high excluding current bar; dip greater than 5% encoded as close < 0.95 * highest_high(365).
Lookback for most recent high is not stated, 365 daily bars chosen with alternatives in free_parameters.
No exit is stated; max_hold_bars 1 chosen to allow re-entry on each day the dip condition holds, approximating repeated dip-day buying in a one-position-at-a-time engine.
Claim cites period May 1, 2013 to May 23, 2021 as evaluation window only, stored in claimed not as rule.
Rule 3 (>10% dips) mentioned but this spec compiles Rule 2 (>5% dips) only.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: daily $1 position sizing / DCA accumulation ladder and holding the accumulated balance to the end; engine holds one position at a time so repeated buys are tested as successive 1-bar trades.

evidence.quote: Don't Buy Until There's a Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price
Dip Greater Than 5% from the Most Recent High Price

audit_majors: max_hold_bars: Claim accumulates dip-day buys and holds to May 23, 2021 with no exit; spec forces exit after 1 bar (max_hold_bars 1) testing successive 1-day bounces instead of long-term accumulation. NOT EXPRESSIBLE note does not cure the change in what is tested.
